images.alt: Luxury fashion couture fragrance advertisement for a fictional perfume called “Le Poop Perfume,” photographed like an ultra-premium Parisian beauty campaign. A glamorous woman with luminous warm skin, tousled elegant brunette updo, ornate gold chandelier earrings and a dramatic black ruffled couture gown poses confidently beside an oversized faceted crystal perfume bottle filled with warm amber-rose liquid, topped with an elaborate polished gold crown cap.
